Data goes in, async callbacks come out. onSave gets a cleaned Discount and the intent (draft or live); return field errors to show them on the sentence or the rule rows, or throw to show the message in the save bar. Errors appear when a field is left, never while typing. New discounts save from the header (Save draft and Create discount). Existing ones use the shared IslandBar, which appears only when there are unsaved changes.

Discount Builder is the page a merchant uses to create or edit a discount. A new discount opens with a short type dialog: amount off products, amount off order, buy X get Y or free shipping. After that the offer is a sentence the merchant edits in place: “Customers get [15%] off [Ring Vase and Glass Carafe]”. Each underlined part is a real control with a label, so screen readers hear “Percentage off, 15” rather than a sentence of buttons.

Everything optional sits in a Rules card as collapsed rows: Minimum purchase, Customers, Usage limits, Combines with and Schedule. Each row shows its current value, so a merchant can read the whole setup without opening anything, and each panel explains its setting with an example. Schedules start now by default and offer presets for 7 days, 30 days and the end of the month, in the store’s time zone.

The rail is a preview, not a list of settings. It shows the offer as one sentence and a sample checkout built from your products, with the discount applied and what the customer saves. A Qualifies / Doesn’t toggle swaps to a cart just under the minimum and shows the same message a storefront would, such as “Add $10.00 more to use SUMMER15”. Risky settings, like 100% off with no limit, show up as warnings under it.

applyDiscount
applyDiscount(discount, cart, { collections }) returns line discounts, subtotal, discount and shipping totals, total, qualifies and a reason when it doesn’t.
sampleCart
sampleCart(discount, products, { qualifies, collections, preferredIds, shipping }) returns a cart that crosses the minimum or just misses it, or null when every cart qualifies.
